name: Pokemon Manager
description: PKHeX-powered save manager: move Pokémon between games, perform trade evolutions, and inject Mystery Gifts, Mystery Events and e-Reader cards.
author: ProClifo

changelog.v0.2.36: Pak Store release. Gen 3 Egg summary page, markings, centred HP, update check on start.
changelog.v0.2.37: No more confirmations for illegal files. Ageto Celebi in Gen 3 Distributions in every language. Gen 1 Mew gets a random tour trainer name.
changelog.v0.2.38: Clock: Y sets the game's clock to the device's time.
changelog.v0.2.39: Distributions: Wishmaker Jirachi, Ageto Celebi, 10th Anniversary and other names without all caps.
changelog.v0.2.40: Karrablast and Shelmet evolve by trading between your Gen 5 saves.
changelog.v0.2.41: Gen 5 sprites and box icons from Black/White and Black 2/White 2, and Black/White box wallpapers.
changelog.v0.2.42: Fixed missing Gen 5 sprites for Meloetta, Genesect, Deerling, Sawsbuck and other form Pokémon.
changelog.v0.2.43: Gold/Silver/Crystal: daily Mystery Gift (items and decorations), once unlocked in the Goldenrod Dept. Store.
changelog.v0.2.44: Mystery Gift list fits the screen.
changelog.v0.2.45: Gen 2 Mystery Gift: one gift at a time; items wait at the Pokémon Center, decorations are sent home.
changelog.v0.2.46: Gen 2 Mystery Gift: a waiting item goes straight to its message.
changelog.v0.2.47: Gen 2 clock keeps the game's day count, so setting the time no longer resets daily events.
changelog.v0.2.48: Gen 2 Mystery Gift: "Sorry—only five gifts a day." after the fifth gift.
changelog.v0.2.49: Save states are backed up to PokemonManager/Backups instead of deleted. Backups keep the last 32 saves and 32 save states per game. Save state settings removed.
changelog.v0.2.51: Player sprites for Black/White and Black 2/White 2 saves on the saves list.
